metrics.help: Total octets received on the interface (64-bit counter).
Total octets transmitted out of the interface (64-bit counter).
Unicast packets delivered to a higher layer (64-bit counter).
Unicast packets requested for transmission (64-bit counter).
Multicast packets delivered to a higher layer (64-bit counter).
Multicast packets requested for transmission (64-bit counter).
Broadcast packets delivered to a higher layer (64-bit counter).
Broadcast packets requested for transmission (64-bit counter).
Inbound packets that contained errors preventing delivery to a higher layer.
Outbound packets that could not be transmitted because of errors.
Inbound packets discarded even though no errors were detected.
Outbound packets discarded even though no errors were detected.
Inbound packets discarded because of an unknown or unsupported protocol.
Length of the output packet queue.
Estimate of the interface's current bandwidth in Mbit/s.
Current operational state of the interface (1=up,2=down,3=testing,4=unknown,5=dormant,6=notPresent,7=lowerLayerDown).
Desired administrative state of the interface (1=up,2=down,3=testing).
sysUpTime value at the time the interface entered its current operational state.

notes: Focused on ifXTable 64-bit HC counters for throughput to avoid 32-bit wraparound, plus ifTable error/discard counters (no HC equivalents exist) and link-state/saturation gauges. Skipped ifRcvAddressTable, ifStackTable, and ifTestTable as administrative/control tables, and skipped rarely-changing scalars (ifNumber, ifTableLastChange, ifStackLastChange). A single ifIndex->ifName lookup covers all ifIndex-keyed metrics since ifTable and ifXTable share the same index.
